tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Sequences of the chimeric peptides designed for this study. The residues added to the B7-005 sequence are in bold.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Antimicrobial activity of B7-005 and its derivatives. Representative strains of the ESKAPE+E were used, as well as E. coli BW25113 and E. coli BW25113ΔsbmA.
footnotes: # The suffix B7- was omitted from all compound names for clarity. § MIC and MBC were recorded after 18 h of incubation at 37 °C. Results are the mode of at least three independent experiments (n = 3). The geometric mean of the same results is presented in Table S1. Coloured boxes indicate different antimicrobial activity: high activity (green) low or no activity (red).
